title: Packet Storm
summary: One internal host is beaconing to an external server at a suspiciously regular interval.
objectives: Identify internal-to-external connections with regular timing
Look for consistent small payload sizes that suggest beaconing
Determine the C2 server IP address
Calculate the beacon interval in seconds

hints.title: Counting connections
hints.text: Group flows by (src_ip, dst_ip) pair and count occurrences. The C2 pair will have far more connections than normal browsing patterns to a single destination.

hints.title: Narrow it down
hints.text: The beacon source is 192.168.1.201. Filter for that IP and look at which destination has connections every minute.

artifacts.description: Three hours of perimeter firewall flow data (~1000 entries).
